code.cyclomatic_complexity_band: High average complexity across functions → refactor to simplify methods and reduce nesting → target avg complexity ≤ 10 (unlocks band 3).
Multiple functions with high complexity → break down large methods into smaller, single-responsibility functions → reduce high/very_high functions to ≤20% (unlocks band 3).
code.maintainability_band: Incomplete function definition for pdf_reader → complete the function and ensure proper error handling → improve maintainability_score ≥0.60 (unlocks band 3).
Inconsistent naming conventions (e.g., camelCase vs snake_case) → standardize naming across the codebase → enhance readability_score ≥0.75 (unlocks band 4).
code.docstring_coverage_band: Missing docstrings for key functions → add comprehensive docstrings for all functions → achieve ≥0.45 coverage (unlocks band 2).
Lack of parameter/return descriptions → enforce complete function signatures with param/return tags → increase docstring_quality ≥0.45 (unlocks band 2).
code.nested_loops_band: Frequent deep nesting (depth ≥4) in data processing → refactor to reduce nesting and improve readability → target depth ≤3 (unlocks band 3).
Lack of tests for critical functions → implement unit tests for key components → ensure reliability and robustness (unlocks band 4).
infra.parallel_patterns: No timeouts implemented → add timeouts to pool tasks → prevent indefinite blocking (unlocks band 4).
No graceful shutdown mechanism → implement a way to terminate the pool cleanly → enhance operational safety (supports band 4).
infra.security_hygiene: Remove hardcoded values and use environment variables or a secrets manager → eliminate exposure of sensitive data (unlocks band 3).
Implement robust input validation and error handling → enhance security against injection attacks (supports band 3–5).
infra.data_pipeline: Implement a structured orchestration framework (e.g., Airflow, Prefect) → define a clear pipeline with retries and validation → unlocks band 3.
infra.feature_engineering: Integrate preprocessing functions into a structured pipeline → ensures reproducibility and persistence → unlocks band 4.
ml.framework_maturity: Fragmented library usage → consolidate to a primary framework with idiomatic usage → improve clarity and consistency (unlocks band 4).
ml.data_validation: Implement schema validation checks → establish clear data quality rules → ensure data integrity (unlocks band 3).
Add drift monitoring mechanisms → track data distribution changes over time → enhance anomaly detection (supports band 3).
ml.experiment_tracking: Logging inconsistent → implement structured logging for parameters and metrics → consistent tracking (unlocks band 3).
No artifacts → save model outputs and visualizations as artifacts → reproducible experiments (supports band 3).
No signature → define and log model signatures for reproducibility → clear model serving (supports band 3).
ml.hpo_practice: No HPO strategy implemented → integrate a search method (e.g., Optuna) → enable systematic exploration of hyperparameters (unlocks band 4).
No persistence of parameters or results → implement logging of best parameters and results → improve reproducibility (supports band 4).
ml.training_practice: Entrypoint structure missing → define a main function with clear configurations → organized training process (unlocks band 3).
No checkpointing or resume functionality → implement checkpoints for model state saving → robust training (supports band 3).
ml.evaluation_practice: No calibration metrics → implement evaluation metrics for model performance → enhance reliability (unlocks band 4).
Fairness not addressed → include bias assessments in resume parsing → improve evaluation completeness (supports band 4).
